customer-jane: We're seeing truncated JSON when streaming with structured output. The last field is cut off and there's no closing brace. Happens intermittently (3/10 requests). Sample attached.

liz (support): Sorry about that — can you paste the curl you used and a raw streaming output snippet (exact bytes)?

customer-jane: curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' 'https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?stream=true' -d '{"prompt":"...","structured":true}'

Raw server stream (truncated):
{"id":"req-123","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"{\"message\":\"done\",\"meta\":\"ok\""}}]  <-- ends here, missing closing } ] }

mike (eng-runtime): Looks like final bytes dropped mid-object. Any proxies/CDNs in path?

customer-jane: traffic flows through Fastly -> ALB -> our VPC. Trace id x-trace-9.

sam (infra-ops): Can you share connection logs? any 'connection reset by peer' entries?

customer-jane: logs show 'write failed: connection reset by peer' and TCP FIN from Fastly around same timestamp.

liz (support): Can you reproduce with a simple curl loop? Also try adding 'Accept: text/event-stream' or setting stream=false as workaround.

customer-jane: Repro script attached; reproduces with python requests streaming in 2/5 runs.

mike (eng-runtime): Hypothesis: LB/edge closes the TCP mid-chunk when keepalive probes or idle thresholds align with chunk flush boundary. Two mitigations: 1) ensure each SSE event contains a fully balanced JSON object (don't split across events) 2) send a final empty SSE event 'data: [DONE]\n\n' before closing.

sam (infra-ops): Also recommend increasing Fastly idle timeout or enabling 'streaming keepalive' on the edge. We'll check Fastly logs for RST.

mike (eng-runtime): Quick server-side patch: after emitting final token call flush() and sleep 50ms before closing socket; or explicitly send '\n\n' to terminate SSE event. Canarizing fix now.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: eng-runtime/stream-final-flush v2026.3 -> us-east-1

customer-jane: trying now... one run succeeded, second failed.

mike (eng-runtime): Thanks — increasing delay and adding explicit '[DONE]' sentinel; pushing new canary.

deploy-bot: canary updated: v2026.3.1

customer-jane: ran 20 loops, 20/20 success now. Great. :tada:

liz (support): We'll keep monitoring. I'll follow up with a formal RCA and ask infra to liaise with Fastly if RSTs persist.

customer-jane: thanks all, appreciate fast turnaround :heart: 

liz (support): marking thread for escalation -> eng-runtime ticket created (#IR-4821).
